paragraphs: He is mentioned in Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit, beginning of chapter 3: he asked Rabbi Chiyya bar Ba. Hyman says Seder HaDorot’s reference to Shevuot is an error.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The Guggenheimer digital text of Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 3:1 has Silni asking Rabbi Chiyya bar Ba, supporting that reading of the supplied compressed לר׳. This is a digital-text comparison, not a claim about printed letter forms.

The whole Guggenheimer Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 3:1 paragraph gives Silni asking Rabbi Chiyya bar Ba. It supports the local full title and question direction, without altering the supplied גר׳ or claiming printed-letter verification. The current mixed note remains verbatim, including its inherited compressed-form wording. Seder HaDorot’s Shevuot reference and error judgment remain Hyman’s report, without fresh collation.
